audit.why: Brand out-pokes pre-6 with W/passive burn while Janna has only Q wind-up and autos; Janna's Eye of the Storm shield and Monsoon disengage take over once she finishes support items.

audit.whatIsWrong: full-layer phases[0-6].side all read 'Skill', but content win[0-5] say 'Brand' and win[6] says 'Janna' — the two layers disagree on every row.
audit.why: Content whys are specific and kit-grounded (W-on-E double burst pre-shield, Pyroclasm one-shot potential at 6, Monsoon countering the all-in late); full-layer 'Skill' rows are generic filler with no grounded reasoning behind them.
audit.corrected: Moved full phases[].side to match content win[] (Brand for levels 1 through first item, Janna for 2+ items/teamfights) and rewrote each .why to state the same kit-grounded reason as the content layer.

audit.whatIsWrong: missingInteractions flags that Janna's Monsoon (R) heals through chip damage and Grievous Wounds timing matters against it; itemization only says generic 'anti-heal' with no source named, and misgenders Janna as 'his'.
audit.why: enemyKit R flags.heal: 'anti-heal target — Grievous Wounds timing matters'. Janna is she/her per champ-gender authority.
audit.corrected: Named Monsoon explicitly in report[8].t and fixed the pronoun.

edits.before: W-poke the pair — the pillar splashes bot's formation tax from level 1.
edits.after: At level 1 your W and passive out-poke Janna's single-target Q wind-up.

edits.before: E joins: the ablaze-stun package threatens; the lane flinches at level 2.
edits.after: Your level-2 W-on-E burst threatens a kill before she has shields online.

edits.before: Full kit: E-Q stuns through the wave and the W bills the dodge attempt.
edits.after: At level 3 Pyroclasm-setup and Blaze damage keep her permanently pressured.

edits.before: Rotation-chip the margins — three spells on anyone is a detonation event.
edits.after: Through levels 4-5 your combo out-trades her weak poke every exchange.

edits.before: Pyroclasm online — grouped duos pay the bounce tax; never lane in a line.
edits.after: Your level-6 Pyroclasm on a stunned target can one-shot her backline.

edits.before: First item: the burn compounds and the stun package deletes.
edits.after: First-item Blaze burn out-damages her Q poke and shield uptime.

edits.before: Late support Brand is a teamfight bill: spread the blaze, R the clump, and stun the survivors.
edits.after: At 2+ items Janna's Monsoon and Q disengage hard-counter your Pyroclasm all-in.

edits.before: W the pair, E the ablaze, Q the stun, walk — the package billed two and the burn collects after.
edits.after: Land E then Q on the same target — the doubled spread and stun punish before her shield covers it.

edits.before: Q-poking clean targets while the engage waits — the unablazed Q is the kit's most expensive miss.
edits.after: Splitting Q onto the support alone lets her ADC free-hit while Zephyr slow saves her partner.

edits.before: World Atlas start. Liandry's, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early into his duo’s sustain.
edits.after: World Atlas start. Liandry's, Sorcerer's, then Rylai's-Zhonya's paths. Add anti-heal early — Monsoon (R) heals through it.

edits.before: - Janna Howling Gale: matchup-defining — The charged tornado breaks every engage — bait it before committing the dive. The duo’s tempo bends around it. - Keep E-Q stun package banked for their best play. - The ultimate is a fight decision, not a habit.
edits.after: - Janna Howling Gale (Q): 14s flat cooldown — the charged tornado breaks every engage; bait it before committing the dive. Her tempo bends around it. - Keep E-Q stun package banked for their best play. - Monsoon (R, 130/115/100s) is a fight decision, not a habit.

notes: Chart mismatch was the priority fix: full phases[].side said 'Skill' on every row while content win[] already carried a real Brand-early/Janna-late verdict backed by specific kit reasoning, so the full layer was moved to agree rather than the reverse.
